extension.summary: Access your content from Easynews and Debrid Clouds.
extension.description: This add-on is intended for advanced Kodi users only. You must own the content of any media you play through this addon. Fen Light's menus are in English; the paired CocoScrapers module provides selectable source-language filtering.
extension.disclaimer: The author of this addon does not host any of the content which is found and has no affiliation with any of the content providers.
extension.news:
[B]Private Fen Light build 2.2.05.6 by Tinkerer[/B] - Added Preferred Source Language in External Scrapers settings. English is the default, with Any Language and supported non-English choices. - Added Default Video View presets for Fanart and Media Info 3. Fanart remains the default, while manual IDs and Tools - Set Views remain available. - External scraper cache keys now include the selected source language so changing the language refreshes filtered results. - Fen Light now defaults movie, TV-show, season, and episode containers to the Confluence Fanart view. - Existing Media Info 3 view settings are migrated to Fanart by the installer helper. - New private profiles now default to the paired CocoScrapers module. - Deferred Fen's self-restart after metadata changes until the next Kodi launch to avoid service shutdown stalls. - Added shutdown checks before custom skin preparation and Trakt network work. - Corrected external-cache reads and expiry deletion. - Hardened background workers, playback abort handling, dialogs, and Kodi shutdown. - Disabled the retired upstream updater; use KodiPortable Install.bat for updates. - Kept Kodi's reusable language invoker enabled for playback stability. - Paired CocoScrapers 1.0.32.3 with selectable source-language filtering and updated providers. - Restored Bitsearch, EZTV, TorrentQuest, Rutor, and ShowRSS as enabled providers. - Premiumize selection, resolution, and API behavior were not changed.
See Changelog in Tools for the complete private-build details.
